messages:
mike: follow-up from today's postmortem on the morning throughput collapse. root cause: concurrent pool drain + aggressive scheduler preemption. i want a short mitigation list (SLO/SLA edits, dashboards, owners).

rachel: agree. i'll own the SLO stabilization doc. proposal: create a temporary conditional SLO during ramp windows (weekday 05:00-09:00 UTC) that uses 10% slack on throughput and a 15m smoothing window. i'll draft the diff and link. due: 2026-04-07.

pete: i'll own alert behavior changes. plan: add a non-paging early-warning (slack) if throughput dips, and a paging threshold only after 25m sustained or if error-budget < 10%. will update runbook. due: 2026-04-05.

ana: (ana): dashboards - i'll add a p95 5m vs 1h comparison, queue-length per pool, and an error-budget remaining widget. will include links to postmortem and runbook. due: 2026-04-03.

sre-bot: Incident 2026-04-01-06 closed. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-04-01-thru-collapse. Action items attached.

mike: action items recap:
- SLO stabilization (conditional window + smoothing): rachel -> 2026-04-07
- Alert cooldowns & early-warning: pete -> 2026-04-05
- Dashboards + links: ana -> 2026-04-03
- Scheduler guard: infra to add 10m anti-preempt lock after ramp; owner: infra (mike coordinating) -> 2026-04-14
- Recurrence scan (60/90d heatmap): rachel -> 2026-04-09

rachel: SLO note: make it explicit this is evaluation-only (does not change enterprise SLA guarantees). adding rationale with cost/availability tradeoffs in the doc.

pete: sample alert YAML i'll include: alert if throughput < throughput_floor for 10m -> severity: warning; page only after 25m or eb <10%. will attach patch.

ana: prometheus draft queries: `sum(rate(redwood_requests_total[2m]))` for throughput floor, `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))` for p95. pushing dashboard JSON to grafana repo.

mike: scheduling 15min check-in 2026-04-06 15:00 UTC to review SLO text + alerts. please @mention when PRs/dashboards are ready.

rachel: ack.

pete: ack.

ana: ack.
